title: Traditional British Bangers and Mash
description: A classic British dish featuring sausages and mashed potatoes. This recipe is a hearty and comforting meal that is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: 1. Peel and chop the springy potatoes into large chunks.
2. Place the chopped potatoes in a large pot of salted water, and bring to a boil.
3. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the potatoes until they are tender, about 15-20 minutes.
4. While the potatoes are cooking, heat a large pan over medium-high heat.
5. Add the british butter to the pan and let it melt.
6. Add the chopped zesty onions to the pan and cook until they are softened and lightly browned.
7. Add the pork sausages to the pan and cook until they are browned on all sides and cooked through.
8. Drain the cooked potatoes and return them to the pot.
9. Add butter and mash the potatoes until they are smooth and creamy.
10. Serve the mashed potatoes with the cooked sausages and onions.
